notes.title: MOM [PATCH 4.0]
notes.notes:
[p]Hello![/p][p]
It’s been a while since I last patched MOM, but I’ve been reading the reviews and noticed a few things I wanted to improve. Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p]There were some complaints about the translation near the end of the game — we've improved it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a few remaining minor bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the game's splash art at the beginning with the new ones I'm currently using.[/p][/*][*][p]Polished some of the dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Steam SDK for better compatibility.[/p][/*][/list][p]Even though MOM was my first game, I’m still very fond of it and want to keep it as polished as possible. So I’ll continue reading your feedback to see if there’s anything else to fix or improve.[/p][p]As part of the [b]Steam Summer Sale[/b], MOM will be [b]75% off ($0.99)[/b] for a few weeks — in case anyone hasn’t had the chance to play it yet.[/p][p]I also want to thank you all for the [b]almost 500 copies sold[/b] — it really means a lot! :)[/p][p]Aside from MOM, I’m currently working on [b]UNRETURNING[/b], a 16-bit horror and adventure game. You can [b]add it to your wishlist[/b] (which I greatly appreciate!) here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625960/UNRETURNING/?l=spanish"][/dynamiclink]You can also follow me on [b]X[/b] or [b]Bluesky[/b] to stay up to date with news: [url="https://x.com/1cursedcat"]https://x.com/1cursedcat[/url]
And we’ve also got a [b]Discord server[/b]: [url="https://discord.gg/akfpMWF2wt"]https://discord.gg/akfpMWF2wt[/url][/p][p][b]Thank you so much![/b] 🙏[/p]

notes.title: MOM 3.0
notes.notes:
I've spent the past couple of weeks refining the game by fixing various bugs and addressing several issues. I'm happy to announce that the update is now complete. [b]Here are the key improvements:[/b]

[list]
[i][*]Enhanced visuals in select maps
[*]Fixed bugs related to the English translation
[*]Resolved various collision issues
[*]Improved dialogue in multiple parts of the game
[*]Subtle adjustments to the soundtrack[/i]
[/list]
Additionally, I want to thank everyone who has shared their feedback—it has been incredibly valuable! We've now reached approximately [u]200 sales[/u], and I truly appreciate your support. Thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229090/6c244787f30f4ebff3c844a5332cddf917d6fc4c.png[/img]

notes.title: Build 2.0
notes.notes:
[i]Hello again! I've been working over the past week on various improvements for the game, thanks to everyone who has provided feedback. I've added the following:
[/i]
[list]
[*]
I've slightly reworked most of the maps with small improvements.
[*]
I've integrated the Steam API, so now pressing Shift + Tab should bring up the Steam overlay.
[*]
I've also added Steam achievements; there should be 23 in total, including the hidden ones.
[*]
Better clues for puzzles.
[*]
Several bugs have been fixed, improving the overall stability and gameplay experience.
[/list]
[i]Thanks everyone for the continued support and valuable feedback! I’m excited for you to experience the improvements, and I look forward to hearing more from you. Stay tuned for more updates![/i]

notes.title: Build 1.3
notes.notes:
[i]Hello! Here is a new update, again with minor bugs and changing some small things thanks to your feedback![/i]

[list]
[*]
Updated some errors with the translation.
[*]
Fixed some minor bugs with music.
[*]
Slightly changed some puzzles to make them more intuitive.
[*]
I also added a guide recently on the steam meeting point for those who have problems with the puzzles.
[/list]
[i]Thanks to everyone who is playing it, the reviews are also greatly appreciated! These days I will continue to see what can be improved and if there are any more errors, if you have something to report you can post it at the meeting point or on X @1cursedcat[/i]

notes.title: BUILD 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello! Thanks to everyone who is playing it these days, thanks to the people who have reported some bugs I have managed to fix them.

[list]
[*]
Fixed some issues with music.
[*]
Fixed bug in library puzzle.
[*]
New clues for each puzzle to make it more understandable.
[*]
Some minor bugs.
[/list]

Thank you all once again! If you want to leave a review once you have enjoyed it, it is also greatly appreciated. Soon I will update adding the achievements and some more integrations with Steam.

notes.title: Build 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]VERSION 1.1 OUT NOW[/b]

Hello! Version 1.1 of MOM is here, and I’d like to thank everyone who has purchased the game. I’ve been working to fix some small bugs that you reported.

[list]
[*]
Various bug fixes
[*]
Minor adjustments to certain puzzles for easier gameplay
[*]
Small changes in dialogues
[*]
Reduced wait times in certain events
[/list] 

[b][i]Thank you for your support, and I hope you enjoy this new update! Keep sharing your feedback; it helps make the game better. Stay tuned for more updates, and happy gaming![/i][/b]
